qa.title: Q2414 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If this follower has 1 fusion counter and I play its On-Evolve ability selecting an enemy follower equipped with a Princess Sword, how much damage will it take?
qa.answer:
When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player who controls the follower receiving the damage decides the order in which the abilities are applied.

However, in this case, since the modifiers are +2 and -2, both orders would result in the follower taking 3 damage.

qa.title: Q2413 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If this follower has 1 fusion counter and I super-evolve it while my opponent has a Shion, Immortal Aegis on the field, how much damage does this follower deal to Shion and the enemy leader?
qa.answer:
The player with control of the Shion, Immortal Aegis (in this case, your opponent) would decide if they take 0 damage or 2 damage.

When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order in which the abilities are applied. In this case, depending on the order, the final damage taken can be calculated either of the following two ways:

1. Your opponent decides to apply Shion's ability first, reducing 1 damage to 0. Then, since taking 0 damage doesn't count as taking damage at all, there is no instance of damage that would be modified by +2.

2. Your opponent decides to apply the +2 damage first, modifying the damage taken to 3, which is then reduced to 2 by Shion, Immortal Aegis's ability.

qa.title: Q2457 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If I have 2 copies of this follower on my field and both of their abilities take effect, how many times is damage prevented to my leader?
qa.answer: 2 times. Since the first instance of damage would be prevented, it would not trigger the second instance of this follower's ability, which would persist until your leader would take damage again.

qa.title: Q2438 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If this follower is on my field and my opponent has a Destruction in Black on the field, in what order are the abilities resolved at the start of my opponent's main phase?
qa.answer: At the start of the opponent's main phase, both this follower and Destruction in Black's abilities would trigger and become pending. The turn player's pending abilities resolve first, and Destruction in Black would deal 2 damage to your leader before you resolve this follower's ability.

qa.title: Q2437 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower with 0 attack, such as Bellringer Angel, attacks my leader, does it use up this follower's effect?
qa.answer: No. Attacks made by followers with 0 or less attack do not count as having dealt damage, so this follower's ability would remain in effect.

qa.title: Q2436 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: Can my opponent use a follower's ability, such as Azazel's On Evolve ability, to change my leader's defense while this follower's ability is in effect?
qa.answer: Yes. Modifying defense isn't the same as dealing damage.
